title: Observed previous-year frequency entry
description: One observed frequency (weightage) computation. Every entry exposes its numerator, denominator, included papers and years, and classification confidence, so a reader can always see what a number counts. Validated by hand-written checks in tests/pyq/test_pyq_foundation.py (D-0006).

numerator.description: Number of classified questions in this subject/topic/type. null until counted.

denominator.description: Total classified questions across the included paper set. Must be non-null and > 0 whenever numerator is non-null.

basis.description: Counted from PYQs. Never OFFICIAL; the official figure is a different file (official_marks_structure.json).

partial_coverage.description: Required when status is PARTIAL: how many of the intended papers/questions were counted.

invariants: numerator != null  =>  denominator is non-null and > 0
denominator == 0 or null  =>  numerator must be null (a count over zero is not a count)
status == COMPLETE  =>  numerator and denominator are non-null and papers_included is non-empty
status == PARTIAL  =>  partial_coverage is present and states counted/intended
papers_included non-empty  =>  every listed paper id resolves to a registered paper
an entry is never relabelled T1_OFFICIAL; observed frequency is not policy
